requirements.label: Minimum Age
requirements.detail: Patient must be 6 months of age or older.

requirements.label: Confirmed Diagnosis
requirements.detail: Documented diagnosis of moderate to severe atopic dermatitis.

requirements.label: Prior Treatment Requirement
requirements.logic: ONE of the following must be documented

options.label: Topical Calcineurin Inhibitor
options.detail: Failed trial of a topical calcineurin inhibitor (e.g., tacrolimus, pimecrolimus).

options.label: Systemic Immunosuppressant
options.detail: Failed trial of a non-corticosteroid systemic immunosuppressant (cyclosporine, azathioprine, methotrexate, or mycophenolate mofetil).

options.label: Exception: Contraindication to All Step Agents
options.detail: Documented contraindications to all listed topical agents and systemic immunosuppressants, and documented inability to use phototherapy.

requirements.label: Demonstrated Clinical Response
requirements.detail: Treatment has resulted in significant improvement or stabilization, including decrease in affected BSA, pruritus, or severity of inflammation, and/or improved quality of life.

quantity_limits.note: Limits are formulation- and age-dependent. Loading dose exception applies at initiation.

schedules.formulation: 200 mg / 1.14 mL pre-filled syringe or pen
200 mg / 1.14 mL pre-filled syringe or pen
300 mg / 2 mL pre-filled syringe or pen
300 mg / 2 mL pre-filled syringe or pen

quantity_limits.loading_dose_override: For atopic dermatitis in patients age ≥ 6 years, 2 additional 200 mg or 300 mg pre-filled syringes/pens may be dispensed in the first month of therapy.

exclusions: Not approved in combination with oral or topical JAK inhibitors.
Not approved in combination with systemic immunosuppressants (cyclosporine, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil, methotrexate).
Not approved in combination with ensifentrine, tralokinumab, reslizumab, benralizumab, lebrikizumab, nemolizumab, mepolizumab, tezepelumab, or omalizumab.
documentation_checklist: Confirmed diagnosis of moderate to severe atopic dermatitis.
Patient age documented as at least 6 months.
Chart documentation of prior treatment failure for at least one qualifying agent.
If exception pathway: documented contraindications to all step agents and inability to use phototherapy.
For continuation: documented clinical improvement or stabilization.
